title: 第121章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

落云这么想,是有缘由的。

就在前几日下了一场新雪，落云和入宫的韩瑶在御花园的暖阁里吃糕饼，顺便赏一赏暖阁外飘零的雪花。

就在这时,韩逍也来了，自从被郑小姐折了面子后，韩逍也知道自己的诗词斤两，再想起以前宴会上别人对自己的奉承有多少水分,就变得有些不爱出宫见人,且需要些日子来修补一下自己受损的自尊。

现在就算面对一地新白,昔日雅气十足的韩逍也毫无诗兴可发,只是抱怨宫人扫雪不及时,害得他差点摔倒。

韩瑶看他的丧气样,逗趣道：“都快娶媳妇了，怎么人倒变得俗起来了？以前下雪时，你向来是要吟诵半日的。等你成亲之后，跟弟妹出去立府,二人吟诗作对,当真是神仙眷侣啊！”

韩逍当时翻的白眼仁都要从眼眶里掉出来了：“我哪敢在大儒的孙女前班门弄斧？她可别用她祖父的笔给我脸皮戳漏了。”

这话一出，韩瑶被逗得哈哈大笑。

韩逍跟嫂嫂和姐姐一起赏雪饮茶,再续杯茶水的时候,怀夏特意绕过去给他添的。

这原也没什么，不过韩逍低头看了看茶水对怀夏说了一句：“还是你最贴心，早知道就不让你去哥哥的院了。”

怀夏当时听得脸一红，偷偷看了太子妃一眼，赶紧退下了。

落云表面不动声色,却看了一眼韩逍的茶杯,发现里面放了一颗甜梅。

原来韩逍饮茶却不耐茶的涩味,最喜欢往里放些梅子了，这是近身伺候他的丫鬟才知道的。

怀夏能这么做也是有缘由的。之后落云闲问了寄秋一嘴，才知道怀夏跟着世子入京前，原本是韩逍院子里的侍女。

只是世子当时进京，宗王妃作为主母总要给大儿子挑些贴身的丫鬟，年龄还不能太小，毕竟韩临风也那么大了，入京总得有些通房的丫鬟。

再加上怀夏这丫头模样怪俊的，宗王妃也怕她耽误了韩逍的学业，就把怀夏拨给了韩临风。

起初这些丫头们都挺高兴的，毕竟世子爷生得俊美，气质脱俗，若是成为他的妾侍，成了半个主子也不错。

可惜这位世子爷无论在外面怎么花天酒地，回来后对自己府里的丫头却看都不看一眼。

怀夏以前也曾经跟寄秋她们抱怨过，早知道这样，还不如继续跟着二公子呢。

毕竟以前怀夏还是挺招韩逍喜欢的。再然后就是苏落云入府，她们又被拨去服侍世子妃了。

听到这，苏落云才恍然，原来怀夏跟老二还有这样的渊源，也难怪她知道二皇子的习惯，给他的茶里添梅子了。

随后几次，落云都发现这怀夏对二皇子有些上心。

就算韩逍是他的旧主子，以前在梁州府里时，她可没看见怀夏这么对韩逍有意无意地示好过。

其实细细一想，也很简单。以前在梁州府里，韩逍就算娶妻纳妾，还要在宗氏的跟前过日子，怀夏不得宗王妃的喜欢，王妃又不许下人带坏她的小儿子，自然要避忌些。

可是现在，公公进京做了皇帝，韩逍一下子变成了皇子，等成亲后，就要出去立府自己封王过日子了，若是能成为王爷的侍妾，岂不是比出去嫁普通人要强？

更何况现在韩逍对未过门的未婚妻颇有微词，那郑小姐又是饱读诗书的女子，也做不出磋磨下女的事情来。若是能再跟二皇子，当真是比出府要强。

摸清了怀夏的这点小心思，落云觉得第一个就应该先将她打发了。

小叔子现在还没有成婚，可是已经定了亲事。

如果这个节骨眼，怀夏成了韩逍的通房，等以后郑小姐嫁过来，搞清楚了夏氏从东宫出来了，就算不明面说出来，心里也会起了误会，以为是兄嫂往弟弟的房里塞人。

再加上香草和寄秋也是到了该嫁人的年龄了，落云便索性一起跟她们讲了，给这几个丫头都好好安排一下前程。

不过这三个大丫头听她说要安排她们嫁人的反应，她也是看在眼里。

香草是不舍主仆之情的悲伤，寄秋是暗自欢喜，而怀夏却是带着无尽的懊丧。

落云将怀夏的反应看在眼里，也知道自己先前的怀疑并非多想。

她事后趁着其他两个丫头出去的时候，还特意点了点怀夏：“虽然二皇子跟我们一样都住在宫里，可是再过些日子，他便要成亲迎娶郑家姑娘了。我看你这几日总是有事无事地往二皇子的宫院跑，是那边有什么相熟的丫鬟故人吗？”

她问得虽然语气平和，可是怀夏却知道自己伺候的这位太子妃是眼里不揉沙子的，以前眼盲的时候都是心思透亮，现在更是瞒不得她。

所以怀夏决定趁着太子妃给她定亲前，还是自己先说，说不定主子心软，就成全了她呢！

想到这，她扑通跪下道：“太子妃！奴婢一心仰慕二皇子的才学，您若是想换换身边伺候的人，请将奴婢赏给二皇子吧，我以前就是二皇子院里的，二皇子为人好，也对奴婢怜惜有佳。奴婢过惯了宫里的日子，不想出宫嫁人！”

落云语气平和道：“你若是在梁州说出这样的话来，只要二皇子和母后同意，我会立刻放你过去。可是现在，这是在宫里，二皇子又是定了亲的人，我这个做嫂子的凭什么赶在大婚前往小叔子的房里塞人？”

怀夏咬了咬嘴唇，小声道：“……那二皇子若是现在来求您，是不是我就能过去了？”

落云想着这几日那怀夏总是面色含春，偷偷痴笑，心里便明白，她应该是跟老二有些什么眉目了。

还是那句话，若是在梁州时，他俩生情，可以用情难自已来解释。

可是现在到了规矩更严的宫里，怀夏却逾矩来了这么一出，显然是存着投机的心思。

既然自己的话都已经点到了这个份儿上，怀夏还是执迷不悟，还妄想用这两年的主仆情给自己前程铺路，落云觉得不必给她留什么脸面了。

所以她淡淡道：“二皇子宫闱的事情不归我管，不过你的事情我会面呈陛下和皇后，让二圣决定好了。”

怀夏一听这话，脸一下变白了，急切喊道：“太子妃，万万不可！您若是说了……那奴婢岂不是没活路了！”

落云眸光微微变冷：“你也知道不妥，却想拱着我为你出头，怀夏，你在我身边这么久，我竟然没看出你还有这么大的心思！”

There is a reason for Luoyun to think so.

There was a new snowfall just a few days ago. Luoyun and Han Yao, who had entered the palace, were eating cakes in the Nuan Pavilion in the Imperial Garden and admiring the falling snowflakes outside the Nuan Pavilion.

At this time, Han Xiao also came. Ever since he was embarrassed by Miss Zheng, Han Xiao also knew that his poems were poor. Thinking about how much flattery others had given him at previous banquets, he became a little reluctant to go out of the palace to meet people, and needed some time to repair his damaged self-esteem.

Now, even in the face of a completely new white landscape, Han Xiao, who used to be so elegant in the past, had no poetry to express. He just complained that the palace servants did not clear the snow in time, causing him to almost fall down.

Seeing his dejected look, Han Yao said jokingly: "You are about to get married, why have you become so vulgar? When it snowed before, you always had to chant for half a day. After you got married, you and your siblings went out to establish a mansion, and the two of them chanted poems against each other. They really are a couple of gods and immortals!"

Han Xiao rolled his eyes so hard that he almost fell out of his eyes: "How dare I use an ax in front of the granddaughter of a great scholar? Don't let her use her grandfather's pen to embarrass me."

As soon as these words came out, Han Yao was amused and laughed.

Han Xiao was enjoying the snow and drinking tea with his sister-in-law and sister. When he wanted to get another cup of tea, Huai Xia went around to refill it for him.

This was nothing, but Han Xiao looked down at the tea and said to Huaixia: "You are the most considerate. If I had known better, I wouldn't have let you go to my brother's hospital."

Huai Xia blushed when she heard this, glanced at the Crown Princess secretly, and quickly retreated.

Luoyun remained calm on the surface, but he took a look at Han Xiao's tea cup and found a sweet plum in it.

It turns out that Han Xiao drinks tea but cannot tolerate the astringent taste of tea, and likes to put some plums in it. This is only known by the maid who serves him closely.

There is a reason why Huaixia can do this.Later, Luo Yunxian asked Ji Qiu and found out that Huai Xia was originally a maid in Han Xiao's courtyard before following the prince to the capital.

It's just that when the prince came to Beijing at that time, Princess Zong, as the mistress, always had to choose some maids to be close to her eldest son. They couldn't be too young. After all, Han Linfeng was already so old, so when he entered the capital, he had to have some maids to marry him.

In addition, Huai Xia was a strangely handsome girl. Princess Zong was also afraid that she would delay Han Xiao's studies, so she assigned Hua Xia to Han Linfeng.

At first, these girls were very happy. After all, the prince was handsome and had a refined temperament. It would not be bad to become his concubine or half master.

It's a pity that no matter how much he spends his time outside, he doesn't even look at the girls in his house when he comes back.

Huai Xia had complained to Ji Qiu and the others before. If he had known this, he might as well have continued to follow the second young master.

After all, Huaixia was quite popular with Han Xiao in the past.Then Su Luoyun entered the mansion, and they were assigned to serve the Crown Princess again.

Hearing this, Su Luoyun suddenly realized that Huaixia had such a connection with the second prince. No wonder she knew the second prince's habit and added plums to his tea.

Several times after that, Luo Yun discovered that Huai Xia was somewhat attracted to the second prince.

Even if Han Xiao was his old master, when she was in Liangzhou Mansion, she had never seen Huai Xia show kindness to Han Xiao intentionally or unintentionally.

In fact, if you think about it carefully, it is very simple.In the past, in Liangzhou Mansion, even if Han Xiao married a wife and took a concubine, he still had to live in front of the Zong family. Princess Zong did not like her when she was pregnant with summer, and the princess did not allow her servants to lead her young son into mischief, so she naturally had to avoid it.

But now, the father-in-law came to Beijing and became the emperor, and Han Xiao suddenly became a prince. After getting married, he would go out to establish a palace and become a king himself. If he could become the prince's concubine, wouldn't it be better than marrying an ordinary person?

What's more, now Han Xiao is quite critical of his unmarried fiancée, and Miss Zheng is a woman who has read a lot of poetry and books, so she can't do anything to get her to marry her.If I could stay with the second prince again, it would really be better than leaving the palace.

After figuring out Huai Xia's little thoughts, Luo Yun felt that she should be dismissed first.

My brother-in-law is not married yet, but he has already made an engagement.

If at this juncture Huaixia becomes Han Xiao's first wife, when Miss Zheng gets married and finds out that Xia has left the East Palace, even if she doesn't say it to her face, she will have a misunderstanding and think that her brother-in-law is inserting someone into her brother's room.

In addition, Xiangxiang and Jiqiu were also at the age to get married, so Luoyun simply talked to them together and arranged their futures for these girls.

But she also saw the reactions of these three eldest girls when they heard that she wanted to arrange their marriages.

Vanilla is the sadness of not giving up the love of master and servant, sending autumn is secretly joyful, but embracing summer is filled with endless regret.

Luoyun saw Huaixia's reaction in his eyes and knew that his previous suspicions were not overthinking.

Afterwards, she took advantage of the other two girls to go out and specially nodded to Huai Xia: "Although the second prince lives in the palace like us, in a few days, he will get married to a girl from the Zheng family. I see that you have been running to the second prince's palace for nothing these days. Are there any familiar maids there?"

Although she asked in a calm tone, Huai Xia knew that the princess she was serving had a clear mind. When she was blind before, she had a clear mind, and now she couldn't hide it from her.

So Huai Xia decided to talk to the Crown Princess herself before she betrothed her. Maybe the master would be soft-hearted and grant her permission!

Thinking of this, she knelt down and said: "Princess! I admire the talent and learning of the second prince wholeheartedly. If you want to change the people who serve around you, please reward the slave to the second prince. I used to be in the second prince's courtyard. The second prince is a good person and shows pity to the slave. I am used to living in the palace and don't want to leave the palace to marry!"

Luo Yun said in a calm tone: "If you had said such words in Liangzhou, as long as the second prince and the queen mother agree, I will let you go immediately. But now, this is in the palace, and the second prince is the one who is engaged. Why should I, a sister-in-law, rush to my brother-in-law's room before the wedding?"

Huai Xia bit her lip and whispered: "...If the second prince comes to beg you now, can I pass?"

Luo Yun thought about how Huai Xia always had a springy look on her face and secretly smiled in the past few days, and she knew in her heart that she must have something to do with Lao Er.

Again, if they were in love when they were in Liangzhou, it could be explained by the fact that they were in love.

But now in the palace where the rules are stricter, Huai Xia went against the rules and came like this, obviously with speculative intentions.

Now that her words have come to this point, Huai Xia still persists in her obsession and wants to use the master-servant relationship of the past two years to pave the way for her future. Luo Yun feels that there is no need to save any face for her.

So she said calmly: "I have no control over the affairs of the Second Emperor's palace, but I will present your matter to His Majesty and the Queen, and let the Second Saint make a decision."

When Huaixia heard this, his face suddenly turned pale, and he shouted urgently: "Princess, you must not! If you had said that...then this slave would have no way to survive!"

Luo Yun's eyes turned slightly cold: "You also know that it's wrong, but you want to support me to stand up for you. Huai Xia, you have been by my side for so long, and I didn't realize that you still have such big thoughts!"
